summary: Comprehensive testing of new salon booking features completed. All 11 backend tests passed. All frontend features verified working correctly including: worker deletion confirmation dialog, booking_id generation, success page with payment info, admin reservations table with ID and Uplata columns, and settings page with bank_account/payment_recipient fields.
passed_tests: Booking ID generation: New reservations receive 4-char alphanumeric booking_id (e.g., #FEA0)
Booking ID appears in admin reservations list
Payment status toggle: PUT /api/reservations/{id}/payment-status toggles between pending and paid
Payment status toggle requires authentication (401 without token)
Payment status toggle returns 404 for non-existent reservation
Settings API includes bank_account and payment_recipient fields
Settings API allows updating bank_account and payment_recipient
Worker deletion with future bookings fails with Serbian error message
Worker deletion returns 404 for non-existent worker
Worker deletion requires authentication
All reservations have valid payment_status field (pending/paid)
Frontend: Success page shows booking_id prominently (#FEA0)
Frontend: Success page shows payment info section with bank account, recipient, svrha uplate
Frontend: Success page shows Viber/Instagram instruction
Frontend: Admin reservations table has ID column with #booking_id
Frontend: Admin reservations table has Uplata column with toggle (Čeka uplatu / Plaćeno)
Frontend: Payment status toggle works (changes from Čeka uplatu to Plaćeno)
Frontend: Worker deletion confirmation dialog appears with worker name
Frontend: Cancel button in confirmation dialog closes without deleting
Frontend: Confirm delete shows error for worker with future bookings
Frontend: Settings page has Podaci za uplatu section
Frontend: Settings page has Tekući račun (bank_account) field
Frontend: Settings page has Primalac uplate (payment_recipient) field
Frontend: Settings save button works and shows success toast
seed_data_creation: Used existing seed data. Created test reservations during testing which were cleaned up.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All new features verified working: 1) Worker deletion confirmation dialog with worker name, cancel/confirm buttons, and error handling for workers with future bookings. 2) Booking ID (4-char alphanumeric) generated for new reservations and displayed on success page and admin table. 3) Payment status toggle (Čeka uplatu / Plaćeno) in admin reservations table. 4) Success page shows payment info: bank account, recipient, svrha uplate with booking ID, and Viber/Instagram instruction. 5) Settings page has bank_account and payment_recipient fields under 'Podaci za uplatu' section. Test file at /app/backend/tests/test_new_features.py can be reused for regression testing.
